owner_feedback.source: Owner reported an integrated conversation trial in this chat.
reported: Opening status switched confusingly between listening and speaking.
Requested only a personalized greeting before listening.
Reported incorrect rehab pronunciation and slow latency.
owner_feedback.limit: This feedback does not establish completion of either full S01 live scenario or the revised behavior; exact iOS version was not recorded.

changes: Opening is only Hi <preferred name>, what can I help with?; preferred name is configured privately, never hardcoded in the repository.
Starting/preparing is distinct from actual speaking and listening. An early session handle enables stopping or interrupting the first greeting.

Voice interruption requires confirmed browser echo cancellation and sustained near-end speech checked against a playback reference. Touch Interrupt Nancy remains available during replies. Interrupted replies and late playback acknowledgements cannot satisfy plan/grocery review.

Cancellation aborts superseded reasoning and invalidates late model actions while preserving the conversation. Already committed care commands remain durable and are read back rather than silently rolled back.
Normal speech cancellation discards the pending native inference result and keeps model workers warm; one subsequent request can wait for it to drain.
Whole-word rehab is rewritten to reehab only in synthesis input; source text and care data are unchanged.
Exact greeting audio is cached only in bounded server memory (8 entries, 2 MiB, five-minute expiry). No recordings/transcripts are saved.
End-of-speech pause reduced from 1.2 to 0.9 seconds; an onset buffer preserves the beginning of an interruption within the 45-second input bound.
Explicit initial planning and view navigation use saved authorized facts without inference; substantive reasoning retains gpt-6-sol/high.

automated.skip_reason: Opt-in real-PostgreSQL scenario; database implementation is unchanged in this turn.
automated.final_delta: Only the onset-buffer duration/input cap changed after the broad suite. Final client-voice and speech-activity suites passed 16/16 and production build passed at the recorded final revision.

checks.name: Exact concise configured-name greeting without activity suggestions
Planning entry offers saved breakfast choices
Interrupted reply cannot be fetched again
Interrupted reasoning response does not return a completed reply
Interruption/navigation did not accept or alter the saved plan

https_checks.limit: Synthetic scripted HTTPS checks on the same backend code. Final browser-only echo/onset-buffer refinements were checked separately; no actual iPhone acoustic timing is claimed.

speech_probe.cache_policy: 8 entries, 2 MiB total, 5 minute expiry; greeting pattern only

synthetic_echo_regression.initial_failure: Coarse lag matching missed delayed playback from actual generated Heart speech; three delayed cases falsely interrupted. Replaced with a full bounded lag scan and averaged decimation.
synthetic_echo_regression.limit: Generated speech with digital delay/gain mixing, not physical speakers/microphones, room acoustics or Safari acceptance.

real_service_planning_regression.limit: Synthetic household fixtures and generated acceptance audio with scripted played acknowledgements. Speech onset and audible listening remain a human check.

remaining: Actual revised iPhone/Safari greeting, REEhab pronunciation, mid-sentence interruption, speaker-echo false-trigger and latency acceptance.
Substantive Sol-high reasoning remains a latency bottleneck; the 9.1-second planning turn is not an instant conversational response.
Remaining S01 role/meal-task-identity/wake and intended-participant/data/provider qualification gates.
